name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.4.2: Draw on-fill text on every filled button and selected bubble.
changelog.v2.4.1: Bound the GIF palette on a high-colour screen.
changelog.v2.4.0: Draw the thread as a chat transcript; Name the sender on the first bubble on screen.
changelog.v2.3.2: Store framebuffer pixels through memcpy; Pack framebuffer colours once and fill spans.
changelog.v2.3.0: Add the three large modules (roadmap phase 11); Reach every GPIO, and let zero_label mean what it says.
